      "rationale": "Expands developer-facing block generation tooling by enabling custom multi-recipient coinbase outputs and automatic mempool package assembly. SuperTestnet noted that multiple coinbase payouts are particularly useful for simulating decentralized mining pool protocols like Ocean and Braidpool in regtest."

      "evidence": "Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; updates generateblock parameter parsing and defaults in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.",

      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Fills functional gaps in generateblock that previously forced regtest callers to supply dummy raw outputs and manual transaction queries.
